discovery: Discovery of topological insulators and the quantized quantum spin Hall and quantum anomalous Hall effects

nominees.name: Qi-Kun Xue
nominees.affiliation: Southern University of Science and Technology and Tsinghua University, China

subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological phases and quantum transport
motivation: Kane, with Mele, showed that spin-orbit coupling can produce a time-reversal-invariant topological insulator classified by a Z2 invariant, with protected helical edge states. Molenkamp's group observed the quantum spin Hall effect in HgTe/CdTe quantum wells in 2007: quantized edge conductance in a real semiconductor device. Xue's group used precise MBE growth of magnetic topological insulator films to observe the quantum anomalous Hall effect in 2013, a quantized Hall resistance at zero magnetic field. Together these works made topology a measurable transport property of materials. They created one of the largest fields in condensed matter physics, which now spans topological superconductivity, magnetic topological materials such as MnBi2Te4, and proposals for dissipationless electronics and topological quantum computation. Their robust quantized signatures in disordered, imperfect samples are an outstanding case of theory and experiment advancing together.
